label: HAGAKURE · THE BOOK OF THE SAMURAI
title: How samurai made hard decisions.

label: I · SEVEN BREATHS
title: Make your decision within seven breaths.
sub: Think too long and fear starts talking.

label: II · BIG THINGS
title: Matters of great concern should be treated lightly.
sub: A calm head makes the big calls.

label: III · SMALL THINGS
title: Matters of small concern should be treated seriously.
sub: Your habits are where it's decided.

label: IV · THE RAINSTORM
title: There is something to be learned from a rainstorm.
sub: You run under the eaves. You still get wet.

label: V · DECIDE FIRST
title: Decide from the start, and the rain won't confuse you.

label: VI · NOW
title: There is nothing but the single purpose of the present moment.

label: HAGAKURE
title: Less thinking. More doing.
sub: Save this for your next big choice.
